title: From Predicates to Ranking Functions: LLM-Proposed, Engine-Validated Candidates for CEGAR-Based Software Verification
description:
Artifact for the Formal Methods (2026) final project report of the same title. VGuide augments CPAchecker with a large language model acting as an engine-validated candidate provider: the LLM proposes a candidate artifact (a loop predicate for safety, or a ranking function with a supporting invariant for termination), artifact-specific checks gate use, and the verifier decides; no unvalidated LLM output can change a verdict (strictly Tier S).

This bundle ships source, prebuilt classes, solver libraries, a termination benchmark subset, recorded experiment summaries, and reproduction scripts. Offline: python3 reproduce_termination.py regenerates report Table 3 (termination 80→84, +4, 0 lost, 0 wrong); python3 reproduce_reachsafety.py checks report Table 2 summaries (Loops ReachSafety 764 tasks, 0 wrong). Live re-run instructions are in README.md. Report PDF included under cpachecker/report/main.pdf.
notes: Reproduction artifact v2.0 for the NTU Formal Methods (2026) final project. Offline: run reproduce_termination.py and reproduce_reachsafety.py under cpachecker/artifact/ (no API key). Full smoke: bash cpachecker/artifact/reproduce.sh. Built on CPAchecker (Apache-2.0).
method: VGuide intercepts CPAchecker at two points: (i) on spurious counterexamples in predicate-CEGAR, an LLM proposes loop predicates filtered by L1/L2 validation before loop-head injection (L3 entailment disabled in all reported runs); and (ii) when lasso-based template synthesis fails, an LLM proposes ranking functions verified by four SMT checks on the lasso before use. Evaluation uses SV-COMP benchmarks; reachability numbers are recorded as summary tables with full reports under artifact/recorded-reports/.
